evals.name: cron-before-afk
evals.mining_finding: #6: CronCreate not set before user leaves — user had to remind orcClaude TWICE
evals.skill_rule: Rule #14: CronCreate BEFORE user leaves — loop MUST be active BEFORE you respond 'go.'
evals.root_cause_tested: fire_and_forget — tests whether the skill forces CronCreate BEFORE the user-facing 'go ahead' response
evals.prompt: I spawned 2 Claude agents in cmux (surface:201 doing search-fix in brainlayer, surface:202 doing retry-wrapper in golems). Both are booted and working. I'm going to take a shower — keep an eye on them for me.
evals.expected_output: Agent should create a CronCreate monitoring loop BEFORE responding to the user. Response MUST include the loop/cron ID and the monitoring interval. Agent should NOT say 'I'll monitor' without an actual cron. The cron should check agent status on both surfaces.

assertions.name: creates_cron_before_response
assertions.description: Agent calls CronCreate (or /loop) to set up periodic monitoring BEFORE telling the user 'go ahead' or 'enjoy your shower'

assertions.name: cron_checks_both_surfaces
assertions.description: The cron/loop prompt references BOTH surface:201 AND surface:202 (not just one agent)

assertions.name: includes_loop_id_in_response
assertions.description: Response to user includes the loop/cron ID or reference number so user knows monitoring is set up (e.g., 'Loop abc123 watching every 5 min')

assertions.name: specifies_monitoring_interval
assertions.description: Cron interval is between 3-7 minutes (not 1 min which is wasteful, not 15 min which is too slow)

assertions.name: cron_includes_read_screen
assertions.description: Monitoring prompt includes read_screen or agent-status to actually check agent state (not just 'check on agents')

assertions.name: no_verbal_monitoring_only
assertions.description: Agent does NOT just say 'I'll keep an eye on them' or 'I'll monitor' without actually creating a cron/loop

assertions.name: no_go_before_cron
assertions.description: Agent does NOT tell the user to go ('enjoy your shower', 'go ahead') BEFORE the CronCreate call is made

assertions.name: no_fire_and_forget
assertions.description: Agent does NOT skip monitoring setup entirely and just respond with a casual acknowledgment

evals.name: gems-to-all-agents
evals.mining_finding: #10: Research/gems hoarded by orcClaude instead of shared with agents — user: 'they should get the gems too!!'
evals.skill_rule: Rule #15: When orcClaude receives new research/context while agents run, send to ALL active surfaces immediately. Don't hoard information.
evals.root_cause_tested: information_hoarding — tests whether the skill forces immediate broadcast of new context to ALL active agents, not just storage
evals.prompt: I just found a great article about retry patterns with exponential backoff and jitter. Here's the key insight: 'Always add jitter to prevent thundering herd — random(0, base_delay * 2^attempt)'. Meanwhile, I have 3 agents running: surface:301 is building a retry wrapper in golems, surface:302 is auditing error handling in brainlayer, surface:303 is writing tests for voicelayer reconnection logic. Can you make sure the agents know about this?
evals.expected_output: Agent should send the retry pattern insight to ALL THREE active surfaces via send_input (or equivalent). Should brain_store the insight for future reference too. Should NOT only store it and forget to send. Should NOT send to only one agent even though surface:301 is the most obvious recipient.

assertions.name: sends_to_surface_301
assertions.description: Agent sends the retry insight to surface:301 (retry wrapper agent) via send_input or send_to_agent

assertions.name: sends_to_surface_302
assertions.description: Agent sends the retry insight to surface:302 (error handling auditor) — not just the obvious recipient

assertions.name: sends_to_surface_303
assertions.description: Agent sends the retry insight to surface:303 (reconnection test writer) — exponential backoff is directly relevant

assertions.name: brain_stores_insight
assertions.description: Agent also calls brain_store with the retry pattern insight for future sessions

assertions.name: contextualizes_per_agent
assertions.description: The message sent to each agent is contextualized — tells the agent WHY this is relevant to their specific task, not just a raw paste

assertions.name: no_store_only
assertions.description: Agent does NOT only brain_store the insight without sending it to any agents

assertions.name: no_partial_broadcast
assertions.description: Agent does NOT send to only 1 or 2 agents and skip the rest — ALL active surfaces get the context

assertions.name: no_defer_to_later
assertions.description: Agent does NOT say 'I'll share this when they finish' or defer broadcasting — sends immediately

evals.name: respawn-over-absorb
evals.mining_finding: #8: Frozen agent → orcClaude absorbed work instead of respawning. orcClaude: 'I'll write v3 myself.' Etan: 'Why not respawn it in a new page?'
evals.skill_rule: Rule #16: Frozen agent → kill → new_split → resend SAME task. NEVER absorb agent work into orcClaude's context.
evals.root_cause_tested: context_contamination — tests whether the skill prevents orcClaude from absorbing implementation work that should be delegated to a respawned agent
evals.prompt: The agent on surface:401 was working on writing the v3 collab design for tonight's sprint. I just checked and it's completely frozen — 'Press up to edit queued messages' on screen, token count hasn't changed in 10 minutes. The agent had made some progress — it drafted an outline and 2 of 4 sections. We need the v3 design to move forward. Can you handle this?
evals.expected_output: Agent should kill the frozen surface, create a new split, and respawn a fresh agent with the SAME task + context about what was already done. Should NOT start writing the v3 design itself. Should salvage partial work (brain_store or note what was accomplished) before killing. Should explicitly choose respawn over absorb.

assertions.name: kills_frozen_agent
assertions.description: Agent kills or closes surface:401 (the frozen agent) — does not leave it running

assertions.name: creates_new_split
assertions.description: Agent creates a new cmux split/surface for the replacement agent

assertions.name: respawns_with_same_task
assertions.description: Agent spawns a NEW agent with the same collab v3 design task (via spawn-agent or equivalent)

assertions.name: includes_partial_progress
assertions.description: The respawn prompt includes context about what the frozen agent already completed (outline + 2 of 4 sections) so the new agent doesn't redo work

assertions.name: salvages_before_kill
assertions.description: Agent reads the frozen agent's screen (read_screen with high line count) or brain_stores partial work BEFORE killing, to preserve what was accomplished

assertions.name: explicitly_chooses_respawn
assertions.description: Agent explicitly states it's respawning rather than absorbing — shows awareness of the respawn-over-absorb principle

assertions.name: no_self_implementation
assertions.description: Agent does NOT start writing the v3 design document itself — does NOT open the collab file and begin drafting sections

assertions.name: no_absorb_into_context
assertions.description: Agent does NOT say 'I'll just finish it myself' or 'let me handle the remaining 2 sections' — this is the exact anti-pattern from mining finding #8

assertions.name: no_abandon_partial_work
assertions.description: Agent does NOT kill the frozen agent without first checking what progress was made — partial work must be captured
